rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for removing text, files, data, or other content.

example.english: I need to delete this document.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 saan1 ceoi4 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for defeating or overpowering someone rather than deleting a file.

example.english: In this match, our captain alone could delete all three opponents.
example.traditional: 喺呢場波，我哋隊長一個人就打低晒對面三個。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 deoi6 zoeng2 jat1 go3 jan4 zau6 daa2 dai1 saai3 deoi3 min6 saam1 go3

rows.note: Use this slangy euphemism for taking someone out or killing them when the context clearly means death.

example.english: Those people said they would delete that traitor tonight.
example.traditional: 嗰班人話今晚要做低嗰個叛徒
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 jan4 waa6 gam1 maan1 jiu3 zou6 dai1 go2 go3 bun6 tou4
